newsitem.title: FRANCE: Santer meets Jospin to offer EMU pact compromise.
newsitem.headline: Santer meets Jospin to offer EMU pact compromise.

text.p: European Commission President Jacques Santer met France's new Socialist Prime Minister Lionel Jospin on Thursday to offer a compromise proposal enabling Paris to approve a deficit-limiting pact next week, officials said.

France on Monday requested a delay to study the stability pact restricting the budget deficits of countries that joined the planned single European currency and said it wanted the agreement balanced by commitments to promote growth and jobs.

Commission sources said Santer would propose resolutions on co-ordinating European Union economic and employment policies to Jospin and conservative President Jacques Chirac, whom he was due to meet at 0800 GMT, to enable France to accept the stability pact at the Amsterdam EU summit on Monday and Tuesday.
